fresh_semantic_judgments.latest: Keep Current unified limit/constrain model with useful contextual branches; add missing restrict A to B as a surface rather than forcing a coarser semantic merge.
Resulting/produced-as-a-consequence adjective is learner Core; vector resultant is specialist noun; generic 'final point in a process' noun should not be learner Active.
Verb resume = continue/begin again; noun résumé = CV is a separate pronunciation/orthographic identity. Generic summary use is lower/formal and must not be fused with CV.
Center stop working/serving and withdraw; domain causative uses may exist, but generic transitive retire sb must not be taught as ordinary fire/dismiss.
Organize reward around benefit/recognition returned for behavior or achievement plus reward sb for/with; behaviorist reinforcement is a domain application, not a coequal learner sense.
Current multi-branch entitlement/correct/appropriate/right-hand model is learner-useful; homophone/confusable boundaries remain Relation debt rather than grounds to flatten the Word owner.
Use circular/bounded/completed-cycle as the organizing model, preserving event-round and approximate/rounded-value branches while avoiding POS-driven fragmentation.
Riding-seat core plus burden extension is sound, and saddle sb with sth is already learner-visible; no Core rewrite is needed.
English sake and Japanese sake are separate lexical/pronunciation identities even though both can live under one spelling owner; identity metadata must make the distinction explicit.
Current Word owner already represents the common authorization/penalty contronym explicitly; do not create a fake cross-word Relation for a same-word contrast.
A scenario is a possible/hypothetical situation or sequence of events; it must not default to 方案/plan.
Past tense of see must be a first-class grammar/form identity, not merely a phrase in the Core text alongside the cutting-tool lexeme.
Current selected polysemy is reasonable and genuinely useful; missing high-value phrasal verbs belong to Expansion debt, not a forced Core flattening.

Biological sex and gender are distinct but related concepts and must not be taught as synonyms; the sex entry should avoid simplistic binary-only equivalence and retain sexual-activity as a separate common sense.
Modern learner value centers Shall I/We offers/suggestions plus formal/legal obligation or future wording; do not teach shall as a routine general future substitute for will.
Vessel and send/transport are Core; software/product ship = release/send to users is a useful current domain extension when context warrants.
